title: Tailoring charge transport in perovskite photovoltaics via chalcogen-thiophene molecular bridges
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17137-17148
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00231E, Paper
Open Access

Mustafa Kareem, Ethar Yahya Salih, M. M. Rekha, Anjan Kumar, Vatsal Jain, Chandra Kant Bhardwaj
This article reports the design and development of a Lewis base molecule, n-Bu4S, formed of fused thiophene units bridged by tetra-pyridine, as a versatile interfacial passivation layer for PSCs.
